This provides no usable instruction to the manufacturer and must be replaced with part-specific values or removed.","recommended_correction":"Delete note N1 or replace every 'XXXXX' placeholder with the actual process, hardness, depth, finish, and coupon size applicable to this part, removing the weld class if welding does not apply."},{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING (IF APPLICABLE) RAW MATERIAL UT HEAT TREATMENT DP+UT FINISH COMPOMENT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N2 lists multiple NDT methods (UT, DP, MPI) generically without specifying which apply to this small anti-rotation block, indicating it was copied from another drawing. Ambiguous inspection requirements can lead to unnecessary cost or missed defects.","recommended_correction":"Revise note N2 to specify only the NDT methods actually required for this part, or remove it entirely if none apply."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 56~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is explicitly marked '---', contradicting note N3 which specifies case hardening, and neither location defines at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies. This ambiguity risks the supplier skipping the treatment or applying it at the wrong stage, ruining dimensions or material properties.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field to match note N3, and add the specific manufacturing stage (e.g., 'after rough machining, before final grinding') to the heat treatment callout."}]}
